addIf.confirmation: A 1H/4H close above the $65,406 rejection high (and ideally the ~$65,631 50-month EMA) that HOLDS confirms a real breakout of the July range — only then deploy the last cash into the larger momentum add on top of the accumulated core.

decisionBox.changed: Shifted from the morning ADD to HOLD (mark only). Nothing broke: BTC firmed a touch to ~$64,500, the $63,700 floor held, $65,406 stayed untested, F&G is still 26 and realized 24h liquidations were light and balanced ($82M, $43M long / $39M short). But the wallet has DCA'd on every session for two days and cash is now nearly exhausted (~$6.6), and at ~$64,500 price sits in the upper third of the box right under the $65,406 cap — a poor DCA location that would buy near resistance, contradicting the week's own 'don't chase the top, accumulate the held floor' lessons. So keep the last powder dry: HOLD the accumulated core, add the momentum tranche only on a close >$65,406 that holds, and reserve cash for a gap down toward the $62,200 magnet. Futures stay flat; no resting stop (price far above the $63,000 reduce level, mid-to-upper range).
